postings.title: Account Manager
postings.description:
Aircall is a unicorn AI-powered communications platform transforming how teams win with customers.

For over a decade, we’ve believed voice builds the strongest business relationships. We bring voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and 250+ integrations together on one seamless workspace—so every customer conversation drives revenue, resolves issues faster, and builds trust. Our AI Voice Agents handle routine interactions while your team leads the conversations that matter most. Used by 24,000+ businesses worldwide.

We’re 600+ people from 40+ nationalities across Paris, London, Madrid, Berlin, New York, San Francisco, Seattle, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused—built for visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

Come join us!

As an Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.

By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.

his is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota-carrying seller. You’ll partner cross-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add-on SKUs, and build deep, long-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.

Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.

This is a hybrid role, in office 3 days a week in Paris.

Key Responsibilities:

- Own NRR: Manage the full post-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.

- Drive Growth: Identify and activate growth opportunities within your portfolio, prospecting into new subsidiaries, use cases, and additional SKUs to unlock untapped potential.

- Target Strategically: Prioritize high-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long-term growth plans.

- Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.

- Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.

- Sell Competitively: Position Aircall’s value head-to-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer’s unique business needs.

- Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty.

- Manage Pipeline & Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data-driven NRR forecasting.

- Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.

- Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall’s product roadmap and go-to-market strategies.

- Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives.

Qualifications:

- Fluency in French and English are mandatory.

- Fluency in Italian is a plus.

- Experienced in SaaS Account Management, Commercial Customer Success, or Renewal Management, with a track record of achieving revenue targets.

- Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy.

- Customer-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.

- Capable of developing and executing account expansion strategies, including stakeholder mapping and whitespace analysis.

- Confident in competitive sales cycles, able to articulate differentiation and handle objections effectively.

- Analytical, detail-oriented, and accountable for forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene.

- Resilient, driven, and passionate about helping customers realize long-term value through partnership.

- Excited by innovation and transformation — particularly the opportunity to represent a next-generation AI-powered communications platform.

Why join us?

🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities

💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall

📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit

🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset

💶 Competitive salary package & benefits

DE&I Statement: 

At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey. 

We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. We’re working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another. We’re committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive. 

We will constantly challenge ourselves to make sure that we live up to our ambitions around diversity, equity and inclusion, and keep this conversation open. Above all else, we understand and acknowledge that we have work to do and much to learn.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. postings.title: Engineering Manager - Shared Application Infrastructure
postings.description:
Aircall is a unicorn AI-powered communications platform transforming how teams win with customers.

For over a decade, we’ve believed voice builds the strongest business relationships. We bring voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and 250+ integrations together on one seamless workspace—so every customer conversation drives revenue, resolves issues faster, and builds trust. We’re 600+ people from 40+ nationalities across Paris, London, Madrid, Berlin, New York, San Francisco, Seattle, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused—built for visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

Come join us!

About the role

We're building a new platform team and are looking for its manager to lead it. You'll bootstrap a team that owns the shared services our engineering teams rely on to deliver features to customers: workflow orchestration, feature flagging, real-time messaging and the API layer.

The team's job is to run this layer properly and offer it back to engineering as a service: reliable, documented, and easy enough to adopt that nobody has to raise a ticket to get started. These services operate at scale (Aircall has over 20,000 customers) and are critical to the smooth operation of our product.

Team shape: we're planning a team of 4 engineers, starting with [first domain to move across, e.g. Temporal]. Planned hiring mix: full-stack and backend engineers with large-scale distributed systems experience.

What success looks like in your first 6 to 12 months

- 

You’ve hired the team.

- 

First domain taken over from the team running it today, with a documented handover and on-call in place, with a roadmap for the others.

- 

Service expectations (for example, OLAs and support levels) published for each owned service.

- 

Quarterly roadmap agreed with the other engineering leads, with protected capacity so support work doesn't crowd out everything else.

What this team will own

This is shared application infrastructure, not AI infrastructure.

- 

Workflow and async execution: Temporal, and the patterns teams use to build on it.

- 

Progressive delivery: feature flagging service, rollout conventions and flag hygiene.

- 

Real-time connectivity: WebSocket infrastructure, connection fan-out, channel authorisation and scaling.

- 

API and graph layer: schema registry, supergraph composition and schema checks in CI.

The team owns these domains rather than any particular product. If we change a tool, the team still owns the job and runs the migration.

Our stack: Python, Go, TypeScript/Node.js / AWS services - EKS, RDS / GitLab CI/CD / Backstage IDP.

Boundaries with other teams

- 

Infrastructure: Infrastructure operates the clusters and core AWS platform; this team runs the shared services on top of it.

- 

Security: Security sets policy and reviews; this team owns the security posture of its services.

- 

Observability: Service-level alerting and dashboards owned by this team.

What you'll be doing

- 

Building the team. You'll hire most of it, set the bar for who joins, and grow the people you hire through coaching, career development and performance reviews.

- 

Taking systems on properly. Each domain moves across from the team running it today. You'll agree what a clean handover looks like, make sure the knowledge comes with it, and take on on-call once the team is ready. Handovers will follow the pace of hiring.

- 

Running a service. Availability, capacity, upgrades, cost, compliance and incident response. You'll publish what teams can expect from you (for example, OLAs and CSAT targets).

- 

Setting the roadmap each quarter or half-year with the other engineering leads, and protecting enough capacity for support work.

- 

Working with our suppliers: cost, contracts, roadmap pressure, and the occasional build-or-buy decision.

- 

Making the supported path the easy path, so teams adopt it because it's the least effort, not because they were told to. You'll use the tools and processes we already have to drive standardisation.

Hands-on expectations: You’ll be hands-on with coding (AI first), design review, and on-call participation, and how this changes as the team grows.

What we're looking for

Must-haves

- Configure and optimize the AI Agent — defining intents, prompts, actions, guardrails, and performance metrics.

- Champion continuous learning and enablement — train peers, run internal workshops, and document best practices to raise the technical bar across the team.

- Client facing experience required

- Strong command of APIs, webhooks, and data structures (JSON, REST, GraphQL) — able to design and troubleshoot integrations confidently. Even better if you have experience with MCP Servers.

- Practical understanding of AI workflow configuration, including prompt engineering, evaluation, and monitoring.

- Hands-on experience with low-code orchestration tools (Zapier, Make, n8n, Workato) and CRM automation (HubSpot, Salesforce).

- Proven ability to lead cross-functional projects, working with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to deliver scalable outcomes.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, translating between technical and business audiences.

- A growth mindset — constantly learning new tools, frameworks, and ways to improve the customer experience and team capability.

- Nice-to-haves:

- Experience in telephony, voice, or contact center systems (SIP/WebRTC, call routing, containment, AHT).

- Familiarity with BI and analytics tools (Looker, BigQuery, Snowflake).

- Exposure to scripting (JavaScript/Python) for light customization and debugging.

- Consistent delivery of high-quality, scalable AI Agent deployments with clear business outcomes.

- Shortened time-to-first-value and increased automation adoption across SMB customers.

- Reusable frameworks, models, and templates actively used by peers and partners.

- Strong collaboration with Engineering and Product to enhance platform capabilities.

About the Role

The FDE Lead is a player-coach, not a traditional people-manager. You'll still be building: personally configuring, deploying, and debugging AI Agent solutions on real customer engagements, because the fastest way to raise the bar for your team is to keep raising your own. You'll also coach the regional FDE team, own the region's AIVA number, and turn what you build yourself into the playbooks and frameworks the team runs on.

Your remit doesn't stop at FDE. You are helping drive the agentic revolution across the whole region, educating our internal teams, collaborating with our marketing team, impact the whole customer journey in your region. 

Core Responsibilities

- Co-own the AIVA number for the region with the regional GM, partnering with AEs, AMs, and CSMs on pipeline and revenue targets, and staying personally accountable for hitting it.

- Stay hands-on and technical: personally configure, build, and deploy AI Agent solutions on a portfolio of strategic or complex accounts, leading by building rather than only reviewing.

- Coach and upskill the regional FDE team on technical execution, agent configuration, and deployment quality through pairing and hands-on review, not just process.

- Build and evolve the global playbooks, reference architectures, and deployment frameworks the team runs on by compounding the team’s knowledge and expertise.

- Drive the region's AIVA go-to-market motion, embedding pipeline hygiene, forecasting discipline, and clear input/output KPIs across the team.

- Run enablement and upskilling sessions in the region, collaborating with the Enablement team so the wider organisation can speak to and support agentic adoption.

- Represent field reality to Product and Engineering, translating what you and the team are building, and where you hit friction, into roadmap input.

- Lead cross-functional initiatives that grow agentic adoption region-wide, coordinating with Marketing, Support, and other GTM teams as needed.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for builders, not career managers — but builders who also have the seniority and business judgement to own a regional number and be credible in front of VP and C-suite stakeholders, internally and with customers. Depth of hands-on experience matters as much as a demonstrated ability to think commercially.

- Hands-on technical depth: 5–6+ years in forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or a comparable role, with a proven track record of personally building, configuring, and shipping integrations or agent solutions, not just directing others who do.

- Technical fluency: comfortable with APIs, integrations, and at least one programming language, with the technical aptitude to quickly get hands-on with new agent capabilities as they ship.

- Commercial and business acumen: able to align technical delivery with revenue outcomes — deal structures, forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and how a deployment translates into the region's AIVA number.

- Executive stakeholder engagement: proven experience engaging and influencing VP and C-suite stakeholders, both internally and at customer organisations, without losing technical credibility.

- People leadership through coaching: demonstrated ability to raise a team's technical bar by building alongside them and reviewing their work hands-on, not by managing from a distance.

- Strategic thinking: able to scope new use cases and opportunities from ambiguity, not only execute against a defined brief.

- Track record of ownership: a clear history of taking complex, cross-functional projects from idea to delivered outcome, and being accountable for the result.

- Entrepreneurial mindset: treats the region like a startup within a startup and doesn't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

Nice to haves

- Experience in conversational AI, voice AI, or contact centre technology.

- Experience with CRMs, help desks, or System-of-Truth integrations.

- Prior experience in an overlay or specialist GTM motion.

postings.description:
Aircall is a unicorn AI-powered communications platform transforming how teams win with customers.

For over a decade, we’ve believed voice builds the strongest business relationships. We bring voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and 250+ integrations together on one seamless workspace—so every customer conversation drives revenue, resolves issues faster, and builds trust. Our AI Voice Agents handle routine interactions while your team leads the conversations that matter most. Used by 24,000+ businesses worldwide.

We’re 600+ people from 40+ nationalities across Paris, London, Madrid, Berlin, New York, San Francisco, Seattle, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused—built for visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

Come join us!

This is an enablement role first — and an AI role because of it.

You'll be joining Aircall's GTM Enablement team at a moment when the function is being rebuilt for an AI-native world. Day to day, you'll be doing what great enablement practitioners do: producing content that changes field behaviour, expanding and managing the Aircall Learning Lab, owning the Highspot-to-Confluence content ecosystem, and making sure our GTM teams have sharp, current product knowledge at their fingertips.

The AI piece is real — and genuinely unusual — but it serves the enablement mission. We're piloting a structured AI Operating Model to make the function faster, more consistent, and more scalable. Your job is to help prove it works by doing excellent enablement work with it.

This internship is based in our Aircall Paris office. Duration will be 6 months.

~60% Enablement Delivery

Content creation, Highspot & Confluence management, Aircall Learning Lab, customer adoption programmes, and GTM product knowledge management. This is the foundation

~40% AI OS Pilot

Operate and extend a production AI Operating Model built on Claude Code — because it makes the enablement work better, faster, and more consistent.

Key Enablement Responsibilities (~60%) : 

- 

Content Design & Creation

This is where you'll spend most of your time. You'll produce assets that AEs, AMs, SEs/CEs, SDRs, Customers, and Partners actually open and use — not documentation that collects dust in a folder.

- 

Design and produce enablement content across formats: playbooks, one-pagers, quick-reference guides, training decks, demo scripts, and certification materials

- 

Write for diverse GTM audiences adapting tone, depth, and format to each persona

- 

Develop visual assets and content layouts that follow Aircall brand guidelines and information design principles

- 

Create micro-learning content: short-form guides, checklists, and job aids that reps can use in the flow of work

Highspot & Confluence Content Management

Aircall's content ecosystem is mid-migration from Highspot to Confluence. You'll own meaningful parts of that transition — not just moving files, but improving them and giving the field a better experience on the other side.

- 

Audit existing Highspot content: assess quality, accuracy, and usage data to decide what gets migrated, updated, archived, or retired

- 

Restructure and improve content as it moves into Confluence — tighter copy, cleaner information hierarchy, better discoverability

- 

Build and maintain Confluence spaces and pages that GTM teams actually navigate (not a graveyard of outdated docs)

- 

Track content performance post-migration and flag gaps or stale material proactively

- 

Establish and maintain tagging and taxonomy conventions that make search and surfacing reliable

Aircall Learning Lab — Expansion & Adoption

The Aircall Learning Lab is the Customer and Partner Academy — the place where customers get onboarded, upskilled, and certified on Aircall products. You'll help grow it and drive engagement with it.

- 

Design and build new learning paths and course content for customers and partners, focused on Aircall core product, AI features, and integrations

- 

Develop certification programmes that give customers and partners a meaningful credential and an incentive to engage

- 

Create session outlines, facilitator guides, and resource packs for live and async learning formats

- 

Track learner engagement, completion rates, and certification uptake — and use that data to improve content and structure

- 

Collaborate with CS and Partner teams to understand where customers get stuck and build content that addresses those gaps

- 

Support scaled engagement campaigns that drive customers into learning paths at key moments in the lifecycle (onboarding, feature launch, QBR prep)

Driving Customer Adoption Through Scaled Engagement

Enablement doesn't stop at the internal field team. You'll help design the content and programmes that get customers using Aircall more deeply — especially around AI features and new releases.

- 

Produce customer-facing enablement content tied to product releases: feature guides, use-case walkthroughs, adoption playbooks

- 

Work with CS and PMM to turn launch communications into structured learning moments — not just release notes

- 

Help design and populate customer-facing resources that CS teams can use to drive adoption conversations at scale

- 

Support road show and customer event preparation with content that lands the product story clearly and concisely

GTM Product Knowledge Management

A GTM org is only as effective as its product knowledge is current. You'll be a key part of keeping the internal knowledge base accurate, accessible, and actually used.

- 

Maintain and improve the GTM Knowledge Base structure, navigation, and search experience in Confluence

- 

Partner with Product and PMM to translate new releases into crisp, field-ready content — FAQs, battlecards, one-pagers, talk tracks

- 

Own a content lifecycle process: identify stale content, flag gaps, coordinate updates with SMEs, and publish on time

- 

Support the GTM KB redesign initiative, contributing to information architecture and design system implementation

- 

Serve as the connective tissue between Product launches and field readiness — so no AE is caught off guard by a feature they've never heard of

AI Operating Model Pilot (~40%)

This is the part that makes the role unique — but being a unicorn only makes sense on top of excellent enablement fundamentals.

You'll be embedded in a live experiment: a production AI OS built on Claude Code that gives the enablement function persistent operational memory, deterministic workflows, and a tool ecosystem (Slack, Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Docs, Jira). The experiment only matters if the enablement output improves. That's the test.

Months 1–2: Learn the System

- 

Get onboarded onto the existing AI OS instance and shadow core workflows (/scope, /think, /roadmap, /eow)

- 

Document what works, what's confusing, and what breaks — from a genuinely fresh perspective

- 

Start using Claude Code to accelerate your own enablement tasks: content drafting, KB audits, learning path outlines

Months 2–4: Operate and Extend

- 

Build your own skills for recurring enablement tasks (e.g. "generate a one-pager from a product brief," "audit a KB article against the style guide," "draft a learning path outline from CS call notes")

- 

Write context documents that feed the system's operational memory

- 

Test skill portability — can a workflow you build be used by a teammate with minimal modification?

- 

Begin documenting what a team-wide AI OS looks like vs. a single-operator one

Months 4–6: Design for Scale

- 

Tackle the hard multi-user problems: skill governance, shared vs. personal context, onboarding playbooks, permission models

- 

Define the measurement framework: how do you prove this produces better enablement outcomes, not just faster ones?

- 

Produce the primary deliverable: GTM Enablement AI OS Team Deployment Guide, tested with at least one other team member

- 

Draft the cross-departmental scaling proposal if successful (what changes going from 6 people to 60?)

Qualifications:

Required

- 

Strong writing and content design instincts. You take complex information and make it clear, scannable, and useful for a busy field audience. Documentation, tutorials, course content, structured blogs — all counts.

- 

Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Web Development, Digital Communications, or a related field blending technical and communication skills.

- 

Comfortable in a terminal. You don't need to be a senior dev, but you shouldn't be afraid of the command line.

- 

Basic familiarity with git and version control. Branching, committing, PRs — you'll work with markdown files in repos.

- 

Strong written English. The team operates in English; French is a plus for Paris office life.

- 

Genuine curiosity about AI as a productivity tool, not just a novelty — you should have opinions about how LLMs should and shouldn't be used.

- 

Structured thinking. You can break an ambiguous problem into steps and document your reasoning.

Strongly Preferred

- 

Experience creating instructional or educational content — training materials, e-learning modules, how-to guides, technical documentation

- 

Eye for information design — you notice when a document is hard to scan, when a slide buries the point, when a help article doesn't answer the question

- 

Familiarity with Highspot, Confluence, Notion, or similar content management or knowledge management platforms

- 

Experience with markdown as a working format for real documentation and knowledge management (not just README files)

- 

Exposure to AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) used seriously for work, not just trivia

- 

Basic understanding of APIs and integrations — "Claude talks to Slack via an API" should make intuitive sense

- 

Interest in enablement, education design, or knowledge management — the AI OS is a means; better GTM outcomes are the end

- 

Any experience with SaaS, B2B, or tech companies, even as a user or in a previous internship

Would be a plus

- 

Familiarity with LMS platforms or learning experience design (xAPI, SCORM, or equivalent)

- 

Google Apps Script, Confluence administration, or Jira configuration experience

- 

YAML familiarity and prompt engineering concepts

- 

Data analysis skills (Python, SQL, or advanced spreadsheet work) — for measuring content performance or AI OS impact

- 

Video editing or multimedia content creation experience

What success looks like:

By Month 3

✓ 2+ enablement assets shipped and actively used by the field

✓ Highspot content audit complete — migration plan in motion

✓ At least one new Learning Lab module live and tracking engagement

✓ Go-to person for at least one content domain

✓ Independently using the AI OS for your enablement work

✓ 3+ original skills built and usable by teammates

✓Highspot-to-Confluence migration complete — content restructured, not just moved

By Month 6

✓ Learning Lab expanded with 

measurable uptick in customer engagement and certifications

✓ GTM KB is current, well-structured, and actively used by field teams

✓ Customer adoption content in place for at least 2 major product areas

✓ AI OS Team Deployment Guide exists and has been tested

✓ Before/after impact documented on 2+ enablement workflows

What you'll learn

- 

Enablement craft. How to design content and programmes that actually change field and customer behaviour — not just materials that tick a box.

- 

Content ecosystem management. How to run a Highspot-to-Confluence migration without losing institutional knowledge or momentum.

- 

Learning programme design. How to build, launch, and iterate on a Customer and Partner Academy that drives measurable product adoption.

- 

Knowledge management at scale. Information architecture, content lifecycle, multi-audience content strategy.

- 

AI agent system design. How to deploy and govern AI workflows for real business use cases — knowledge that barely exists in the market right now.

- 

Cross-functional collaboration. Working across Sales, CS, Product, PMM, and Engineering teams

Why this matters

Most companies are giving employees ChatGPT access and calling it "AI transformation." That's not transformation — that's a search engine with better prose.

The thesis behind this role is that AI becomes dramatically more useful when you give it structured operational memory, deterministic workflows, a tool ecosystem, and the ability to improve its own processes over time. postings.description:

For over a decade, we’ve believed voice builds the strongest business relationships. Aircall's AI suite includes an AI Voice Agent and AI Messaging Agent that autonomously handle calls, WhatsApp, and SMS, plus AI Assist, which delivers real-time coaching, call summaries, and CRM automation for sales and support teams. We are looking for someone that can build out the evaluation foundation across all of these products and other agentic products. You'll work on voice models, agent capability evals, benchmark design, LLM-as-judge systems, failure analysis, and the infrastructure that ties it together by establishing shared metrics, test sets, and tooling to measure accuracy, resolution quality, and safety consistently across products. You will set up repeatable pipelines for regression testing and benchmarking as models and features evolve so teams can ship confidently without re-inventing evaluation methodology for each product.

Key Responsibilities

- Design and document comprehensive evaluation frameworks for Aircall’s AI agents across voice, chat and messaging.

- Train and fine-tune voice models (TTS, ASR, speech-to-speech) using production and synthetic data, iterating on architecture, data mix, and training strategy to improve accuracy, naturalness, and latency.

- Assess AI generated solutions across training pipelines, experimentation setups, debugging processes, and optimization strategies. 

- Analyze system design decisions and identify strengths, weaknesses, and potential failure points.

- Design annotation guidelines and workflows for human-labeled evaluation data, and calibrate LLM-as-judge systems against human raters to ensure automated evals stay trustworthy over time.

- Build and maintain live quality monitoring for deployed AI agents, tracking accuracy, resolution rate, and safety signals in production, and flagging model or data drift before it impacts customers.

- Own the metric contract for every published AI metrics, including definition, population, grain, rollup, validity window.

- Build release gates, the offline regression suite each AI surface must pass before a prompt, model, or config change ships, measuring reliability across repeated trials, not just average pass rates.

- Build voice-specific evaluation: simulated callers across accents, languages, background noise, barge-in, DTMF, and tool failures, with latency and ASR accuracy as first-class quality metrics.

Our AI Voice Agents handle routine interactions while your team leads the conversations that matter most. Used by 24,000+ businesses worldwide.

Come join us!
Why This Role Exists

The Manager of Customer Engineering leads the CE organization in their region and ensures customers experience a smooth, consistent and value-focused journey from onboarding to renewal. They manage a team of Customer Engineers and Scaled Customer Engineers responsible for activation, technical configuration, workflow guidance, adoption coaching, and proactive portfolio health management.

This leader brings strong implementation and project management expertise into the post-sales organization. They ensure onboarding and adoption motions follow structured frameworks, meet the regional quality bar, and align with global playbooks. They work closely with Enablement to apply these playbooks with discipline, and with the leader of CE and SE to refine them to match real customer needs.

Partners play a critical role in scaling onboarding capacity. Partnerships and Partner Enablement provide trained and vetted partners, and the CE Manager decides when and how to leverage them. They supervise partner execution, ensure alignment to CE standards and help the CE team treat partners as an extension of their capacity so internal CEs can focus on the most impactful work.

This is a hands-on leadership role. The Manager joins customer calls when needed, supports escalations, ensures AI activation across their portfolio and leads the CE team with technical confidence, operational discipline and customer empathy.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead, Develop and Manage the Regional CE Team. This includes daily coaching, hiring, performance management and skills development for a team of approximately five to six Customer Engineers and Scaled Customer Engineers. The Manager ensures consistent delivery of onboarding, activation and adoption and builds team confidence, structure and technical depth.

- Expand Capacity Through Delivery Partners. The Manager works with Partnerships and Partner Enablement to understand which vetted partners can support onboarding. They decide when to involve partners, oversee partner output to ensure quality and help the CE team view partners as an extension of their bandwidth.

- Own Technical Execution Across Onboarding, Activation and Adoption. They guide the CE team in delivering onboarding using structured project management principles with clear timelines, accurate configuration and high-quality communication. They ensure smooth activation, early adoption and workflow success.

- Drive Customer Health and GRR Outcomes. The Manager is accountable for Healthscore performance and Gross Revenue Retention across CE-managed accounts. They help the team identify risks early, intervene before renewal cycles and join renewal conversations when advanced technical input is required.

- Apply Global Playbooks and Adapt Them Locally. They collaborate with Enablement and the leader of CE and SE to execute global onboarding and adoption playbooks with consistency and improve them based on local realities and customer feedback.

- Collaborate Across Sales, CS, Support, Product and FDE. The Manager aligns with Account Management Leaders on renewal readiness and customer prioritization. They oversee escalations with Support and Product, and collaborate with FDEs when advanced technical guidance is required.

- Join Customer Calls When Needed. They join onboarding, adoption, escalation or renewal conversations when their leadership presence or technical acumen will meaningfully support outcomes or strengthen customer confidence.

- Lead Regional Projects and Select POCs. They contribute to regional process improvements and may run targeted proof of concepts for new onboarding or adoption workflows.

- Run a Data-Driven CE Operation. They track onboarding throughput, activation quality, AI usage, partner delivery quality, escalations and health signals. They use data to coach the team, optimize processes and refine workload prioritization.

Competencies and Capabilities

- People Leadership and Talent Development. Ability to coach and elevate mid to senior technical contributors and build a high-performing CE culture.

- Project Management Excellence. Deep project leadership skills grounded in implementation experience including timeline management, customer communication, scoped onboarding plans and high standards of delivery.

- Operational Discipline and Playbook Execution. Comfort with enforcing repeatable workflows and documentation standards and skilled at applying and improving global playbooks.

- Partner-First Leadership. Understands how to expand capacity through delivery partners and oversees partner performance to ensure alignment with expectations.

- Technical Understanding and Curiosity. Comfortable discussing workflows, integrations, troubleshooting patterns and configuration logic and guiding CEs through technical problem solving.

- AI Fluency. Understands Aircall’s AI features and ensures the CE team drives activation and adoption consistently.

- Scaled Education Mindset. Informed understanding of webinar-led onboarding, customer education programs and scalable enablement flows.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration. Works confidently across AM Leaders, Support, Product, FDE and Enablement to support customers across their journey.

- Data-Driven Judgement. Uses data and KPIs to guide coaching and improve operational efficiency.

- Calm Under Pressure. Able to provide clarity and structure in escalations, complex onboarding issues and renewal risk scenarios.

Experience and Background

- 7+ years of experience in a customer-facing SaaS environment, ideally in onboarding, implementation, technical support or technical customer success as both IC and Leader.

- Demonstrated success leading full implementation or onboarding projects from kickoff to go-live with clear timelines, customer communication and structured delivery.

- Experience managing a technical team, including coaching, performance management and skills development across multiple seniority levels.

- Experience coordinating with delivery partners or external onboarding vendors, including oversight of partner quality and alignment to internal standards.

- Hands-on exposure to technical configuration, integrations, workflow setup or troubleshooting within SaaS products.

- Familiarity with customer health management and retention drivers and experience supporting teams on renewal readiness.

- Experience supporting adoption of advanced product features such as analytics, automation workflows or AI.

- Strong cross-functional experience working with Sales, AM Leadership, Support, Product and Enablement in a post-sales context.

- Data-driven mindset with experience using dashboards, health or usage signals to guide actions and improve customer outcomes.

- Excellent communication skills including ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Comfort balancing structured onboarding motions with scalable education formats such as webinar-led sessions.

This role sits within GTM Enablement, part of the broader Customer Solutions & Applied AI organisation responsible for turning Aircall's AI Voice Agent (AIVA) and AI Messaging Agent (AIMA) into adopted, well-understood products across the business. As Product Enablement Manager, you will own how the field learns about every new AI Agent capability, use case, and release. This is a jack-of-all-trades, full-stack role: you need to be technical enough to understand agentic concepts such as intents, prompts, guardrails, and evals, creative enough to turn them into content people actually engage with, and comfortable producing that content yourself end to end, from writing through to filming and editing video. You'll work hand in hand with Forward Deployed Engineering to understand what the field actually needs, and directly with Product and Engineering to get ahead of what's shipping next. You are expected to be AI-first in how you work, using AI and agentic tooling to write, edit, and produce content at a scale a traditional enablement function could not, and to find agentic ways to enable the organisation more broadly, not only through content.

Core Responsibilities

- Own internal and customer enablement for every new AIVA and AIMA launch, translating roadmap items and release notes into playbooks, one-pagers, and videos for Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Product Support, and GTM.

- Produce video as a default enablement format: script, record, and edit feature walkthroughs, demo videos, and "what changed and why it matters" explainers.

- Operate AI-first across the full content workflow, using AI tools to draft scripts, generate and edit video and audio, translate and localise content, and repurpose one asset into multiple formats.

- Build agentic tools and workflows that enable the organisation beyond content, such as internal agents that let teams self-serve answers or auto-generate first drafts of documentation.

- Work in lockstep with Forward Deployed Engineering to understand field pain points and priorities, and directly with Product and Engineering to get early visibility into what's shipping, so every release ships with an enablement plan ready to go.

- Build reusable frameworks, templates, and video formats that make each subsequent launch faster to enable than the last.

- Run live sessions, such as launch briefings or office hours, where they are the right tool, while defaulting to scalable, on-demand content wherever possible.

- Maintain a single, current source of truth for AIVA/AIMA product knowledge across the internal knowledge base or external customer LMS.

- Track enablement effectiveness, including content usage, time-to-competency on new features, and internal Q&A volume, and use that data to prioritise what to build next.

- Feed field questions, confusion points, and gaps back to Product and PMM so future releases ship with enablement already built in.

Qualifications:

- 2–4+ years of experience in product enablement, technical writing, solutions engineering, forward deployed engineering, content/product marketing, or a similar hybrid role at a SaaS or AI/platform company. Candidates without a formal enablement title are welcome if the underlying skills below are there.

- Technical fluency: comfortable with agentic AI concepts (prompting, intents, guardrails, evaluation) and able to hold a credible technical conversation with Product and Engineering without a translator.

- Full-stack content skills: strong written communication, plus the hands-on ability to script, shoot, and edit video end to end, not just brief a production team.

- AI-native operator: you use AI tools fluently for writing, video and audio generation, editing, and content repurposing, and can build simple agentic tools or workflows rather than only using AI as an assistant.

- Proven ability to build something from scratch in a fast-moving environment with minimal structure, team, or budget.

- Strong stakeholder management across Product, Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, and GTM Enablement.

- Analytical mindset, with experience defining and tracking content or enablement effectiveness (usage, time-to-competency, adoption).

Nice to haves

- Experience at a high-growth AI Companies or developer tooling products

- Background in contact centre technology or agentic technology

- Hands-on experience with AI video/audio tools (e.g. Descript, CapCut, Runway, ElevenLabs, Synthesia, HeyGen).

- Experience building lightweight agentic workflows or automations (e.g. Zapier, Make, n8n).

- Prior experience in a formal product enablement, sales enablement, or technical training role.

Inbound. Customers contact us about seat changes, upgrades, downgrades, cancellations, renewals and plan questions. You turn each request into a retained or grown account, using clear playbooks and commercial judgment on pricing and discounts.

- Manage customer renewals end-to-end, including contract terms negotiation, to expand and retain customer revenue, while keeping your forecast and CRM data updated.

- Partner with Fraud Operations and Finance on billing disputes, credit and collections-adjacent edge cases.

- Feed what you learn from customer conversations into our playbooks, signal definitions and product roadmap, with concrete examples and numbers.

- Use AI tools in your daily workflow (research, call prep, drafting, summarization) and share the practices that work with the team.

Profile

- 2+ years of experience in a quota-carrying Sales or Account Management, with a track record of achieving revenue or expansion targets.

- Fluency in French and English.

- Comfortable handling a high volume of calls and proactively engaging an existing customer base.

- Demonstrated ability to close upsell opportunities and manage complex pricing or commercial negotiations.

- Strong analytical skills with experience using data to prioritize accounts, build business cases, and track outcomes.

- Excellent operational acumen and proven ability to manage time and prioritize across a high-volume territory, with a strong sense of accountability and ownership.

postings.description:

We’re 600+ people from 40+ nationalities across Paris, London, Madrid, Berlin, New York, San Francisco, Seattle, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused—built for visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

Come join us!
We are looking for a seasoned Engineering Manager to lead Aircall's Security Engineering organisation. This is a high-impact leadership role spanning four pillars: Product Security, Infrastructure Security, Detection & Response, and Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC). You will grow an established team of security engineers, set the technical direction, and partner closely with Engineering, Product, Legal, IT and Finance to embed security deeply across the company. You’ll scale the team through high impact AI engineering across all 4 pillars.

You will be both a skilled people manager and a credible technical leader — someone who can roll up their sleeves when needed but who ultimately scales their impact through their team. You bring empathy, clear communication, and a bias for pragmatic security outcomes over security theatre.

Scope of Responsibility:

Product Security

- Own the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) from threat modelling through to production deployment.
Secure Agentic development practices by automating threat modeling, code reviews, internal pentesting and vulnerability remediation by building in-house security AI agents.

- Partner with engineering to embed security reviews, static analysis (SAST), dependency scanning (SCA), and secrets detection into CI/CD pipelines.

- Lead the Aircall Bug Bounty and Vulnerability Disclosure Program (VDP), triaging and remediating reports with engineering teams.

- Drive regular penetration testing cycles for web, mobile, and API surfaces; oversee remediation tracking.

- Champion a developer-centric security culture through security champions, training, and tooling that makes the secure path the easy path.

Infrastructure Security

- Define and maintain the security architecture of Aircall's cloud infrastructure (AWS), with a strong emphasis on zero-trust, least privilege, and defence in depth.

- Own, maintain and expand security observability through CSPM, CNAPP and CWPP tools like Wiz.

- Enable agentic auto-remediations for security vulnerabilities.

- Own network segmentation, secrets management, certificate lifecycle, identity & access management (IAM), and workload isolation, and secure hosting of internal AI applications

- Lead infrastructure hardening programs: CIS benchmarks, container security, Kubernetes policy enforcement (OPA), and immutable infrastructure practices.

- Manage the security posture of third-party SaaS tools and vendor risk assessments.

- Collaborate with Infrastructure engineering and Product Engineering on shared security responsibilities and runbooks.

- Build and mature Aircall's threat detection capability — SIEM tuning, alert triage playbooks, and investigation workflows.
Own incident response: develop and test the IR plan, lead tabletop exercises, and act as incident commander for significant security events.

- Drive threat intelligence and threat hunting programs to stay ahead of adversaries targeting the cloud communications sector.

- Establish and track key security metrics: MTTD, MTTR, alert-to-incident conversion rates, and coverage gaps.

- Ensure 24×7 detection coverage through tooling, automation, and on-call rotations, balancing reliability and engineer wellbeing.

- Own and continuously improve Aircall's information security management program, aligned to SOC 2 Type II, and applicable data-protection regulations (GDPR, CCPA).

- Maintain the corporate risk register for information security, presenting findings and remediation plans to senior leadership and the board as required.

- Define and enforce security policies, standards, and exception processes across the organisation.

- Lead, mentor, and grow a multi-disciplinary security team of 6–10 engineers across the four pillars.

- Run structured 1:1s, career-development conversations, and quarterly goal-setting aligned to company OKRs.

- Hire and onboard exceptional security talent; contribute to employer-branding initiatives in the security community.

- Create an environment where engineers feel psychologically safe to raise concerns, experiment, and learn from failures.

- Balance hands-on technical involvement with delegation — staying close enough to the work to be credible, but trusting the team to execute.

- Partner cross-functionally with Engineering leadership, Legal, People Ops, and Finance to align security initiatives with business priorities.

- 7+ years of professional experience in security engineering.

- 3+ years in an engineering management or technical lead role with direct reports.

- Proven track record of building and scaling security teams in a cloud-native, SaaS environment.

- Deep technical fluency across at least two of the four pillars (Product Security, Infrastructure Security, D&R, GRC).

- Hands-on experience with major cloud platforms (AWS strongly preferred, GCP or Azure a plus) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or equivalent).

- Experience owning or contributing to SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, or equivalent compliance programmes.

- Demonstrated ability to communicate security risk clearly to non-technical executives and board members.

- Experience running security incident response — from detection through containment, eradication, and post-mortem.

- Background in a high-growth B2B SaaS or cloud-communications company.

- Familiarity with VoIP, real-time communications, or telephony security considerations.

- Experience embedding Agentic AI practices into security engineering workflows and securing internal AI tooling and implementation.

- Relevant certifications: CISSP, CISM, AWS Security Specialty, GIAC (GWAPT, GCIA, GCIH), or equivalent.

- Experience running a Bug Bounty programme (HackerOne, Bugcrowd, or similar).

- Familiarity with DORA metrics and the relationship between deployment frequency and security posture.

postings.description:
Aircall is a unicorn AI-powered communications platform transforming how teams win with customers.

For over a decade, we’ve believed voice builds the strongest business relationships. We bring voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and 250+ integrations together on one seamless workspace—so every customer conversation drives revenue, resolves issues faster, and builds trust. Our AI Voice Agents handle routine interactions while your team leads the conversations that matter most. Used by 24,000+ businesses worldwide.

We’re 600+ people from 40+ nationalities across Paris, London, Madrid, Berlin, New York, San Francisco, Seattle, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused—built for visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

Come join us!
The embedded technical partner for a focused portfolio of Aircall's most strategic global accounts, driving agentic AI adoption use case by use case, in lockstep with Key Account Managers, from a first deployed use case to platform-wide expansion.

About the Team

Aircall's Forward Deployed Engineering team connects our innovative AI Agents technology to real-world customer workflows. We turn possibility into production by delivering automation that improves customer experience, boosts productivity, and unlocks new business value. Working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions, and Customer Success, the team ensures every deployment delivers measurable impact.

Within that team, this is a senior, Key Accounts–focused role for someone who wants to go deep rather than broad — embedding with a portfolio of Aircall's most strategic global customers and growing agentic adoption inside each one over time. It sits at the intersection of technical consulting, project leadership, and AI adoption strategy. You don't need to be a full-time software engineer, but you should be fluent in APIs, highly confident leading complex technical engagements, and credible in the room with senior customer stakeholders.

About the Role

As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer for Key Accounts, you are the embedded technical owner for a portfolio of Aircall's highest-value global customers. You don't run a deployment and move on — you stay with the account, building a long-term agentic roadmap alongside the Key Account Manager (KAM).

You land a first high-impact use case, prove value fast, then systematically expand the footprint use case by use case until Aircall's AI Agents are woven through the customer's core workflows. This is a high-autonomy role: you set the technical strategy for your accounts, you're trusted in the room with customer leadership, and you act as the connective tissue between the customer, the KAM, Product, and Engineering.

Please note, this is not a software engineering role. This is a hybrid, revenue-driving role spanning Solutions Engineering, Consulting, Professional Services, and Product Ownership

What you'll do

- Own a sustained, embedded relationship with each account in your portfolio — you are the customer's go-to technical authority on agentic AI, not a project resource who rotates off once a deployment ships.

- Partner directly with the Key Account Manager on a joint account plan: the KAM owns the commercial relationship and quota; you own the agentic use-case roadmap and technical execution; together you build and drive the pipeline of expansion use cases.

- Land the first use case fast, then expand — deploy an initial high-value workflow, instrument the outcome, and use proven value to open the next use case and the next buying centre within the account.

- Run an evergreen use-case discovery cadence — continuously surface, qualify, and prioritise new automation opportunities across the customer's teams, so there is always a next use case in flight.

- Serve as the customer's trusted advisor on agentic strategy — map their AI roadmap 6–12 months out, not just the deployment in front of you, and keep Aircall positioned as the platform of record.

- Lead discovery and solution-design sessions with customer stakeholders to map business processes, identify automation opportunities, and define solution architecture.

- Design, build, and deploy integrations using low/no-code platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n, Workato) and CRM automation tools (HubSpot Workflows, Salesforce Flow) with API connectors.

- Configure and optimise the AI Agent — defining intents, prompts, actions, guardrails, and performance metrics tailored to each account's workflows.

- Manage complex, cross-functional deployments — defining timelines, aligning stakeholders, ensuring accountability, and delivering on time and within scope.

- Collaborate with Engineering to validate technical feasibility, resolve blockers, and feed field learnings back into the product.

- Create scalable models and reusable frameworks (templates, playbooks, reference architectures) that make expansion within your accounts — and future Key Account engagements across the team — faster and more consistent.

- Champion continuous learning and enablement — mentor FDEs, run internal workshops, and document best practices to raise the technical bar across the team.

- Collaborate with GTM leadership to embed the routines and cadences that drive accountability for expansion pipeline, forecast accuracy, and performance tracking within Key Accounts.

- Contribute to expansion pipeline and MRR within your portfolio, jointly with the KAM — defining use-case-specific expansion strategies, coordinating cross-functional support, and ensuring Aircall delivers the leading AI-enabled communication platform.

- Shape the AI Agent roadmap with Product and PMM, based on customer needs, integration insights, and field learnings from your accounts.

- Drive internal and external product education, including enablement for System Integrators (SIs) and channel partners where they support your accounts.

- Maintain deep awareness of AI and CX industry trends, ensuring Aircall's positioning stays competitive and insights continuously feed back into product and GTM strategy.

What you'll bring

- 6+ years in technical consulting, solutions engineering, forward-deployed engineering, or integration-focused professional services — ideally with time owning strategic or enterprise accounts.

- Client facing experience:

- Proven ability to own a long-term customer relationship as the technical authority, operating with autonomy and credibility in front of senior (VP / CxO) stakeholders.

- Proven experience running account-based motions in partnership with sales / account management on strategic or enterprise customers.

- Technical skills:

- Strong command of APIs, webhooks, and data structures (JSON, REST, GraphQL) — able to design and troubleshoot integrations confidently. Even better if you have experience with MCP Servers.

- Proficiency in scripting (JavaScript and/or Python) — used to build, customise, and debug integrations, not just read them.

- Hands-on experience with low-code orchestration tools (Zapier, Make, n8n, Workato) and CRM automation (HubSpot, Salesforce).

- Practical understanding of AI workflow configuration, including prompt engineering, evaluation, and monitoring.

- Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional programs with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to deliver scalable outcomes.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, translating fluently between technical and business audiences.

- A growth mindset — constantly learning new tools, frameworks, and ways to improve the customer experience and team capability.

- Nice-to-haves

- Experience in telephony, voice, or contact centre systems (SIP/WebRTC, call routing, containment, AHT).

- Familiarity with BI and analytics tools (Looker, BigQuery, Snowflake).

What success looks like

- Depth and expansion within each account — a growing number of live agentic use cases, and adoption spreading into new teams and buying centres over time.

- Net revenue retention and expansion MRR across your portfolio, driven jointly with the KAM.

- Trusted-partner status — reflected in access, executive relationships, and roadmap influence, not just tickets closed.

- Shortened time-to-first-value on the initial use case, then a repeatable path to use case two and beyond.

- Reusable frameworks and models actively used by peers and partners on other Key Account engagements.

- Strong collaboration with Engineering and Product to enhance platform capabilities.

- Sustained improvements in customer metrics (containment, AHT, CSAT) and revenue impact (ARR, NRR) driven by your solutions.

Why join us?

🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities

💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall

📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit

🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset

💶 Competitive salary package & benefits

postings.location: New York Office; San Francisco Office; Seattle Office
postings.description:
Aircall is a unicorn AI-powered communications platform transforming how teams win with customers.

For over a decade, we’ve believed voice builds the strongest business relationships. We bring voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and 250+ integrations together on one seamless workspace—so every customer conversation drives revenue, resolves issues faster, and builds trust. Our AI Voice Agents handle routine interactions while your team leads the conversations that matter most. Used by 24,000+ businesses worldwide.

We’re 600+ people from 40+ nationalities across Paris, London, Madrid, Berlin, New York, San Francisco, Seattle, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused—built for visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

Come join us!
About the Role

As a Senior Security Engineer, Detection and Response you will develop, scale, and evolve Aircall's threat detection and response capabilities. You will take ownership of building detections from scratch, leading investigations, and driving the maturity of our detection program.

This is an owner-operator role. You will not be solely responding to alerts or consuming a detection platform that someone else runs, you will build and run it: the ingestion pipelines, the Terraform that defines them across sandbox, staging and production AWS accounts, the retention and cost posture, and the automation layered on top. Roughly two-thirds of the work is software and platform engineering; the remaining third is investigation, incident response and threat hunting. Expect to write production Python and Terraform every week, working alongside a product security, cloud and infrastructure security team you will partner with closely.

Our team builds the best solutions to our biggest problems, over the past year we've built our own AI SOC & IR agent, and we're applying those lessons to how we protect customer-facing AI products.

Responsibilities

- Leading direction and strategy of the DART program at Aircall

- Lead end-to-end development of detection logic: from threat modeling and hypothesis to writing, testing, simulation, tuning, and deploying detection rules and alerts across logs, telemetry, host, network, and cloud.

- Own the security data platform end to end. Operate and extend the SIEM and its ingestion pipelines, parsers, enrichment and normalization, defined as infrastructure-as-code and promoted from sandbox to production. Own its cost and capacity envelope and make the retention-versus-spend calls.

- Experiment and build unique tools at the front of the security space that solve significant security challenges.

- Expand and ship new security AI- and agent-based tooling for alert triage, investigation and detection building, including its authorization model, guardrails, evaluation harness and tracing.

- Conduct threat hunts proactively in company wide and production environments, discovering anomalies and attacker behaviors before they escalate.

- Lead incident response: investigate, contain, remediate, and perform root cause analysis. Drive post-incident reviews and feed lessons learned back into detection strategy.

- Assess security around new product features, including AI- and LLM-backed services and opportunities for detections or protections

- Author and maintain detection documentation, runbooks, alert definitions, tuning guidelines, and metrics.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Fraud, Privacy and Legal

- Participate in on-call and threat-response rotations; escalate, coordinate, and remove blockers during high-severity events.

- Stay current on attacker techniques (MITRE ATT&CK, red team reports, threat intel) and propose new detection patterns or responses accordingly.

- Participate in hiring and interview evaluation of Security and Infrastructure engineering candidates, and in team growth.

Should have

About the role
Businesses running on Aircall field calls their teams can’t handle alone, such as after hours, at peak volume or across languages. AI Voice Agent answers them. It is not an IVR or a canned response bot. It is a real-time voice agent that understands context, talks naturally, executes actions mid-conversation and knows when to hand off to a human. The role sits at the intersection of real-time systems, production LLM applications and voice infrastructure, where milliseconds matter and quality is “immediately audible.” This is “production AI at scale,” not prototyping.

What you’ll work on

- Real-time speech pipeline: Live audio buffering, streaming and latency optimization, and evaluating or integrating speech providers.

- Conversation intelligence: Prompt construction, context management, function calling, dynamic knowledge injection and dialogue management.

- Actions and integrations: The action framework, covering configurable API calls, success/failure branching, auth management and the runtime execution engine.

- Knowledge and memory: How agents ingest, store and retrieve knowledge at runtime, and retain information across a conversation.

- Agent lifecycle and configuration: Working with designers so customers can create, configure, test and deploy agents easily.

- Evaluations and quality: Evaluation frameworks per model, post-call analytics, call quality metrics, Datadog instrumentation and the on-call rotation.

What you’ll bring

- Professional fluency, spoken and written, in English and Spanish, or in English and French

- 5+ years with production backend experience, ideally in Python or TypeScript. 

- Fluency with async code, and experience designing for performance and reliability.

- Understanding of how real time systems differ from request/response APIs, including buffering, streaming, connection management and latency tradeoffs.

- Production experience with LLMs or AI/ML systems, including prompt engineering, context management, function calling and reliable AI behavior.

- Experience building or using evaluation tooling.

- Comfort with event driven architectures, message queues, caching and async task processing.

- Experience debugging distributed failures and handling partial failures gracefully.

- A thoughtful approach to testing, observability, API design and code review.

- Clear communication, including writing design docs.

- Familiarity with AI coding tools in day to day work.

Nice to have

- Voice, audio or telephony systems

- STT/TTS providers and models

- LLM evaluation frameworks and quality metrics

- AWS (DynamoDB, Lambda, AppSync, SQS)

- GraphQL API design

- Kubernetes and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Helm)

This role brings together advanced technical capability, consultative depth and commercial impact. Staff CEs work closely with CTOs, Heads of CX, Heads of Digital and operational leaders inside customer organizations. They ensure complex deployments, integrations and AI adoption programs are executed successfully and become drivers of long-term retention and growth.

You are expected to be hands-on, build executive credibility, and successfully navigate high-stakes customer environments.

Key Responsibilities:

- High-Touch, Complex Onboarding: Own onboarding for large, high-complexity customers (250+ employees, 100+ users). Lead deep discovery, map business processes, design advanced workflows and integrations, and drive technical implementation to a smooth, timely, high-quality go-live.

- Senior Technical Partner to KAMs: Act as the day-to-day technical counterpart to Key Account Managers, working 1:1 or 1:2 to deliver a unified commercial and technical approach across technical strategy, risk assessment, renewal readiness, integration roadmaps, and adoption plans.

- Proactive Renewal Support and Technical Reviews: Run quarterly and mid-cycle technical reviews for strategic accounts (covering renewal readiness, ROI articulation, workflow optimization, and integration stability), and help KAMs surface expansion and retention opportunities backed by technical outcomes.

- Add-On Activation and AI Deployment: Deploy and optimize advanced AI add-ons like AI Assist Pro and AI Voice/Messaging Agent optimization (following FDE-led engagements), building customer-specific AI adoption playbooks and becoming a regional expert in AI-enabled workflows.

- Complex Implementations and Solution Architecture: Serve as the technical architect and owner for advanced configurations, challenging integrations, and custom workflow builds, coordinating closely with Engineering, Product, and internal technical experts to deliver bespoke solutions when needed.

- Proactive Monitoring and Advanced Troubleshooting: Review product telemetry, integration performance, and usage patterns to anticipate issues before they surface, and lead root-cause analysis on the most complex product or integration issues that fall outside standard CE motions.

- Escalation Management for Strategic Accounts: Coordinate high-impact escalations end-to-end, driving internal alignment, providing technical direction, leading communication, and maintaining executive trust through to clear resolution.

- Product Feedback and Technical Leadership: Identify recurring technical themes and capability gaps from strategic accounts to inform the product roadmap, mentor CEs and Scaled CEs, and elevate the technical craft across the organization through example rather than people management.

Qualifications:

- Deep Technical Expertise: Strong command of VoIP fundamentals, APIs, integrations, webhooks, data flows, authentication models, cloud architectures, and customer tech stacks, with the ability to read and interpret code (JavaScript, Python, or similar).

- Solution Architecture and Systems Thinking: Comfortable designing complex technical solutions, mapping workflows, orchestrating multi-system integrations, and guiding the long-term technical evolution of customer environments.

- Executive Communication: Able to speak confidently with CTOs, CIOs, Heads of CX, and Operations leaders, translating technical strategy into clear business terms.

- Prioritization and Workload Management: Sound judgment for triaging a large portfolio where touching every account every quarter is not realistic. Able to prioritize time and effort against north star metrics, focusing energy on the accounts and actions that move the needle most.

- Project Leadership: Proven ability to lead multi-stakeholder, multi-phase technical projects with predictable delivery and clear communication.

- Commercial Awareness: Clear understanding of how technical decisions affect renewal, GRR, NRR, and expansion, with the ability to influence commercial strategy through technical insight.

- Ownership and Accountability: A strong sense of ownership over your portfolio and its outcomes, taking personal accountability for retention, churn mitigation, and contraction / GRR performance across your strategic accounts.

- Calm Under Pressure: Maintains confidence and clarity during escalations, high-stakes conversations, and strategic customer interactions.

- Cross-Functional Influence: Effective collaborator with Engineering, Product, Support, KAMs, and FDEs, able to translate customer needs into structured internal actions.

- Languages: Professional proficiency in German and English is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

- 8+ years of experience in Customer Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Technical Account Management in SaaS.

- Strong background in complex implementations, technical onboarding, and solution deployment for mid-market or enterprise customers.

- Hands-on experience with APIs, integration design, low-code platforms, or light coding.

- Prior hands-on experience designing, implementing, or supporting agentic AI workflows, including voice and messaging agents, is strongly preferred.

- Proven success supporting strategic accounts, renewals, and expansions, with direct impact on NRR/GRR outcomes.

- Experience working directly with senior customer stakeholders including CTOs, CIOs, technical leads, or operations executives.

- Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior individual contributor with high autonomy, strong judgment, and technical leadership.

- Demonstrated proficiency with AI-powered productivity tools and large language models (such as ChatGPT or Claude), including their practical application in day-to-day work.

- Background in telephony, communications, contact center, AI, or workflow-heavy SaaS is a strong advantage.

- Professional proficiency in a third language (Spanish or French) is a strong plus.

You’ll report into leadership and act as the first line of support for the AMs you coach, while continuing to carry your own NRR and AI targets and account relationships. You’ll partner closely with Iberia and EMEA leadership, working across CET (Spain) and WET (Portugal) time zones.

Aircall is going through an exciting transformation, building on our market-leading platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently and competitively. In Iberia, you’ll lead in a multilingual market where local relationships, language and business culture make a real difference. Join us and help shape that journey.

This is a hybrid role based in our Madrid office.

Key Responsibilities:

Account Management (Player)

- Own NRR: Manage a smaller book of named accounts across Spain and Portugal, right-sized to allow coaching bandwidth alongside account ownership, and drive renewals and expansion within your book.

- Carry Your Number: Deliver a personal NRR/retention and AI target.

- Know the Market: Adapt your approach to local buying habits, languages and renewal cycles.

- Set the Standard: Model the account management standard you coach others toward: deal execution, pipeline hygiene and customer relationship management.

- Coach Day to Day: Provide day-to-day coaching and skill development for a subset of AMs, primarily newer and developing reps.

- Run the Cadence: Run weekly 1:1s, deal reviews and pipeline inspection with each AM you coach.

- Be the First Escalation: Serve as the first line of escalation for deal support, objection handling and methodology (SPICED) questions before matters escalate further.

- Share Insights: Share regular updates on team blockers, trends, pipeline, risk and churn, and coaching themes.

- Build Talent: Identify skill gaps early and build development plans for underperforming or ramping reps. If an individual’s performance requires a performance improvement plan, it will be administered by the Sr. Manager, Account Management.

- Lead Locally: Adapt your coaching and people management to the cultural and employment context of Spain and Portugal, partnering with HR and local leadership on any formal performance matters.

Qualifications:

- Fluency in Spanish and English is mandatory. Fluency in Portuguese is a plus.

- Current tenure as a high-performing Account Manager on the Iberia team (or equivalent), with a track record of strong NRR/retention results and at least 1 year of tenure as an Account Manager at Aircall, ideally supporting customers in the Iberian market.

- Deep working knowledge of the Aircall platform and AI products (AIVA, AI Assist Pro).

- Fluent in internal tooling (Salesforce, Gong, Hex, Claude) and familiar with the SPICED sales methodology.

- Solid understanding of the Spanish and Portuguese business landscape, including local buying behaviors, negotiation styles and cultural nuances.

- Working knowledge of GDPR and the local data protection and telecom regulations relevant to customer accounts in Spain and Portugal.

- Demonstrated informal leadership: teammates already come to you with questions, or you’ve mentored/onboarded peers.

- Strong judgment on when to solve something yourself versus escalate.

- Comfortable holding both an individual number and coaching accountability for your team at the same time.

- Analytical, with comfort forecasting against NRR and pipeline.

Success Looks Like:

- Your own book hits its NRR and AI targets.

- The AMs you lead show measurable coaching cadence (weekly 1:1s, deal reviews) and improving ramp/performance trajectories.

- Escalations are triaged and resolved at your level where appropriate, with clear judgment on what needs to go further up.
